topic: Your Phone: A City of Billions
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know your smartphone chip holds more microscopic switches than people in many countries? 🤯

Here is the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Inside every microchip in your smartphone or computer, there are billions of tiny electronic switches called transistors. Imagine a sprawling city where every single person is a switch, turning on or off to process information at mind-bending speeds. A single modern smartphone chip can pack more of these microscopic workers than the entire population of countries like Canada or Australia, all working in unison to power your apps, photos, and everything you do.
